# Nada Sai

> Nada Sai is a free, 100% client-side, browser-based web application for editing images, PDF documents and audio files, and for privacy and security tasks such as encryption, hashing and redaction. All processing runs locally in the user's browser using WebAssembly, WebAudio, WebCrypto and Web Workers — zero files or user data are ever uploaded to any server.

## Overview

Nada Sai provides private, offline-first image manipulation (background removal, cropping, compression, conversion, resizing), PDF editing (merging, splitting, page reordering, signing, watermarking, password protection, OCR text extraction), audio processing (cutting, joining, format conversion, bitrate compression), and privacy and security tools (AES-256 file and text encryption, checksums, EXIF/GPS removal, image and PDF redaction, PDF metadata cleaning, password generation, text comparison). Thirty-one tools across four modules.

## Image Tools

- [Remover Fundo / Remove Background](https://nadasai.com/pt/imagem/remover-fundo): Automatically remove background from photos locally using AI.
- [Melhorar Qualidade / Enhance Quality](https://nadasai.com/pt/imagem/melhorar-qualidade): Upscale image resolution (2x, 4x) and sharpen details 100% offline using AI.
- [Extrair Texto / Extract Text (OCR)](https://nadasai.com/pt/imagem/extrair-texto): Recognize and copy text from photos, receipts, and scanned documents 100% offline.
- [Cortar Imagem / Crop Image](https://nadasai.com/pt/imagem/cortar): Crop and resize images with custom aspect ratios.
- [Comprimir Imagem / Compress Image](https://nadasai.com/pt/imagem/comprimir): Reduce image file sizes without quality loss.
- [Converter Imagem / Convert Image](https://nadasai.com/pt/imagem/converter): Convert images between PNG, JPG, and WebP formats.
- [Redimensionar Imagem / Resize Image](https://nadasai.com/pt/imagem/redimensionar): Change image width and height dimensions.
- [Imagens para PDF / Images to PDF](https://nadasai.com/pt/imagem/para-pdf): Convert multiple images into a single PDF document.

## PDF Tools

- [Editor de PDF / PDF Editor](https://nadasai.com/pt/pdf/editar): Edit text, headers, and content directly inside PDF files.
- [Juntar PDF / Merge PDF](https://nadasai.com/pt/pdf/juntar): Combine multiple PDF documents into a single file.
- [Dividir PDF / Split PDF](https://nadasai.com/pt/pdf/dividir): Extract or separate pages from a PDF.
- [Comprimir PDF / Compress PDF](https://nadasai.com/pt/pdf/comprimir): Shrink PDF file size 100% offline.
- [PDF para Imagem / PDF to Image](https://nadasai.com/pt/pdf/para-imagem): Convert PDF pages into high-resolution PNG, JPG, or WebP images.
- [PDF para Word / PDF to Word](https://nadasai.com/pt/pdf/para-word): Convert PDF documents into editable Word (.docx) files.
- [Organizar PDF / Organize PDF](https://nadasai.com/pt/pdf/organizar): Reorder, rotate, or delete PDF pages.
- [Proteger PDF / Protect PDF](https://nadasai.com/pt/pdf/proteger): Add password encryption to PDF files.
- [Assinar PDF / Sign PDF](https://nadasai.com/pt/pdf/assinar): Draw or add digital signatures and stamps to PDFs.
- [Marca d'Água / Watermark PDF](https://nadasai.com/pt/pdf/marca-dagua): Add custom text watermarks to PDF pages.

## Audio Tools

- [Cortar Áudio / Cut Audio](https://nadasai.com/pt/audio/cortar): Trim songs, voice notes, or podcasts 100% offline with visual waveform display.
- [Juntar Áudios / Merge Audio](https://nadasai.com/pt/audio/juntar): Join several audio files into one 100% offline, with crossfade or gaps between tracks.
- [Converter Áudio / Convert Audio](https://nadasai.com/pt/audio/converter): Convert audio files between MP3, WAV, OGG, M4A, AAC, and FLAC formats 100% offline.
- [Comprimir Áudio / Compress Audio](https://nadasai.com/pt/audio/comprimir): Shrink audio file sizes by adjusting bitrate (32 to 320 kbps) 100% offline.

## Privacy & Security Tools

- [Criptografar Arquivo / Encrypt File](https://nadasai.com/pt/privacidade/criptografar-arquivo): Password-encrypt any local file with AES-256-GCM and PBKDF2, entirely in the browser.
- [Criptografar Texto / Encrypt Text](https://nadasai.com/pt/privacidade/criptografar-texto): Encrypt a message into a pasteable armored block using the same AES-256 envelope.
- [Hash de Arquivo / File Hash](https://nadasai.com/pt/privacidade/hash-de-arquivo): SHA-256, SHA-512 and MD5 checksums, streamed in chunks so files of any size can be verified locally.
- [Gerador de Senha / Password Generator](https://nadasai.com/pt/privacidade/gerador-de-senha): CSPRNG password generation with a real entropy readout, no network involved.
- [Remover EXIF / Remove EXIF](https://nadasai.com/pt/privacidade/remover-exif): Show and then losslessly strip GPS coordinates, camera model, serial numbers and embedded thumbnails from JPEG, PNG and WebP — without re-encoding the image.
- [Censurar Imagem / Redact Image](https://nadasai.com/pt/privacidade/censurar-imagem): Burn black bars into the pixels of a photo so the covered content is destroyed, not hidden.
- [Censurar PDF / Redact PDF](https://nadasai.com/pt/privacidade/censurar-pdf): Real PDF redaction — pages are rebuilt as rasters so the text under each bar cannot be copied back out.
- [Limpar Metadados PDF / Clean PDF Metadata](https://nadasai.com/pt/privacidade/limpar-metadados-pdf): Inspect and remove PDF author, producer, dates, XMP and per-page application data.
- [Comparar Texto / Diff Checker](https://nadasai.com/pt/privacidade/comparar-texto): Side-by-side line diff of two texts or files, computed locally with a Myers diff.

## Privacy Architecture

Every URL above exists in both Portuguese (/pt/) and English (/en/) — see sitemap.xml for the pairs.

The no-upload claim is instrumented rather than asserted: NetworkProbeService wraps fetch, XMLHttpRequest, sendBeacon and WebSocket at runtime and counts file egress specifically (any body carrying a File, Blob, ArrayBuffer, typed array, or FormData containing a File). The count is displayed on the home page, so a user can verify the claim in their own browser rather than taking it on trust.
